g.text: Same val rows and axes in all three panels. Tables: MAE (GPa) vs hv_chen per chemical family.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Caption. Predicted vs true hv_chen (Chen proxy from DFT B,G; not measured hardness) on the 374 val rows. Oxides have a positive mean signed error (prediction − hv_chen):

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: +2.6 GPa for c8 and +3.0 GPa for c5, against +0.4 GPa for the SVR (wiki/RESIDUALS_D023.md). Rows above about 20 GPa are mostly underpredicted by all three models (signed

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: errors for the formulas: wiki/RESIDUALS_D023.md). Families are coloured and shaped (marker shape carries family because five hues do not separate for every colour-vision

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: type). Per-family MAE in the tables uses n per family as shown; the binary B/C/N family has only n = 14, so its MAE is imprecise. Per-family MAE and bias are exploratory
